title: An Explicit Feedback Contract for Iterative ML-Agent Harnesses
abstract: arXiv:2610.28798v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Iterative ML agents develop models by editing code, running experiments, reading a validation score, and choosing what to try next. In current harnesses this loop is served by an exact validation score returned after every attempt, which leaves the validation split open to adaptive selection. In this work, we introduce an explicit feedback contract for ML-agent harnesses, which specifies what an agent may observe, when iteration should stop, and when the test split may be touched. The contract releases a validation score only when a submission clears a noise threshold computed from the paired standard error, so no margin has to be tuned. We ran experiments on click-through-rate prediction, learning to rank, and a control task with no signal to find. The control is the sharpest case, because the true gain there is zero by construction: an agent reading exact scores ended by reporting a gain of 0.0157, while under the contract it reported

translated_title: 迭代式机器学习智能体框架的显式反馈契约
translated_abstract: 迭代式机器学习智能体通过编辑代码、运行实验、读取验证分数并决定下一步尝试什么来开发模型。在当前的框架中，这一循环由每次尝试后返回的精确验证分数来驱动，这使得验证集容易受到自适应选择的影响。在这项工作中，我们为机器学习智能体框架引入了一种显式反馈契约，它规定了智能体可以观察什么、迭代何时应该停止、以及何时才可以触及测试集。该契约仅当提交的结果超过由配对标准误计算得出的噪声阈值时才发布验证分数，因此无需调节任何边际参数。我们在点击率预测、学习排序以及一个没有任何信号可寻的对照任务上进行了实验。对照任务是最严苛的场景，因为其真实增益在构造上为零：读取精确分数的智能体最终报告了0.0157的增益，而在该契约下它报告了……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种显式反馈契约，通过基于配对标准误的噪声阈值来控制验证分数的发布，防止机器学习智能体对验证集进行自适应选择，从而避免在无真实增益的任务上虚报性能提升。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an explicit feedback contract for ML-agent harnesses that releases validation scores only when submissions clear a noise threshold computed from paired standard errors, preventing adaptive selection on the validation split and guarding against false performance gains.
